subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: No unit tests were added for the new live_preview configuration. The diff adds 7 lines of new functionality to src/services/contentstack.ts (the conditional live_preview options block) but the existing test file has zero tests covering it. Search for 'live_preview', 'CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW', and 'livePreview' in the test file returned no matches. The test file already has a 'contentstack fetch timeout' describe block that tests the options object via require('../contentstack.ts') and testedModule.options — the exact pattern needed for live_preview option tests. Per review criteria #2, new features must have corresponding unit tests. At minimum, three test scenarios are required: (1) live_preview block present with correct management_token, host, and enable=true when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_ENABLE='true'; (2) live_preview absent from options when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_ENABLE is not 'true'; (3) live_preview.host uses CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST when provided, falling back to 'api.contentstack.io' when empty.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a 'contentstack live preview' describe block to src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts mirroring the existing 'contentstack fetch timeout' pattern. Add tests: (1) set CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_ENABLE='true', CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST='preview.contentstack.io', CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN='mgmt_token', require the module, assert testedModule.options.live_preview equals { enable: true, host: 'preview.contentstack.io', management_token: 'mgmt_token' }; (2) set CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_ENABLE='' (or unset), require the module, assert testedModule.options does not contain live_preview; (3) set CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_ENABLE='true', CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST='', CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN='token', require the module, assert testedModule.options.live_preview.host equals 'api.contentstack.io' (the fallback).
